Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-03
DOoc-0012 2026-10-16
SHIFT NOTES — Cabin Desk Cover Before the Friday
Sweep
Date: 2026-10-16
Station: DEMO-STATION-03
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
07:25 — PERSON-0006 holds the cabin coordination desk for
TEAM-0006 through 12:30. The afternoon cabin desk goes to the
relief coordinator. Other subsystem questions go to the
station roster clerk for a destination; do not put them into
the cabin folder because this desk is staffed first.
08:10 — Keep ISSUE-0095 and TASK-0254 on the cabin reference
card for DEMO-AIR-0009. The card identifies the discussion
material and travels with the desk binder when relief arrives.
It is not a task assignment instruction.
08:45 — Prepare cabin topic cards for the Friday queue sweep
at 09:10. Put longer backlog questions behind the sweep
divider, with an owning role and a next discussion date.
Requests needing a desk response before relief remain on the
front clipboard so that parking them does not hide their
deadline.
12:20 — Brief the relief coordinator at the binder shelf. Read
the afternoon appointments aloud and note which outside desk
has promised a response. Use a dated annotation for any
changed appointment rather than crossing out its history.
Next-shift list
_ Check that the cabin reference card is inside the binder.
_ confirm the afternoon coverage interval with the relief
coordinator.
—~ Bring back the sweep carry list and attach the cabin actions
beside their original topic cards.
D. Worker 0006
Demo Worker 0006, Demo Team 06
